jobs.title: Marketing Director, Americas
jobs.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Marketing Director to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Echodyne is seeking a highly motivated and execution-oriented Marketing Director, Americas to lead regional marketing initiatives across defense, government, critical infrastructure, and advanced air mobility markets throughout North, Central, and South America.

Reporting to the Vice President of Marketing, this role is responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing programs that drive brand awareness, customer engagement, and pipeline growth across strategic regional markets. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with deep awareness of defense and government markets, who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative technology environment, and is comfortable balancing strategic planning with day-to-day execution.

This position works cross-functionally with sales, business development, product management, and executive leadership teams to support long-cycle technical sales efforts and advance Echodyne’s growth objectives throughout the Americas.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop and execute integrated regional marketing programs supporting defense, federal civilian, critical infrastructure, and advanced air mobility markets across the Americas

- Create and manage marketing campaigns that increase market awareness, generate qualified engagement, and support complex technical sales cycles

- Lead development of customer-facing content including collateral, presentations, digital campaigns, thought leadership, case studies, event materials, and product messaging

- Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling messaging tailored to customer, partner, and industry audiences

- Partner closely with sales, business development, product, and sales enablement teams to align marketing initiatives with business priorities and pipeline objectives

- Lead regional event strategy and execution, including trade shows, conferences, customer demonstrations, and partner engagements

- Support partner and ecosystem marketing initiatives with channel, technology, and strategic alliance partners

- Oversee digital marketing execution across web, email, outbound campaigns, and related demand generation activities

- Manage marketing operations workflows within Salesforce Account Engagement and related CRM and automation platforms

- Lead and mentor a small regional marketing team while coordinating external agencies, contractors, and vendors as needed

- Monitor campaign performance, engagement metrics, and marketing effectiveness to optimize programs and resource allocation

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

- 10+ years of B2B marketing experience

- 4+ years within defense technology, aerospace, sensor, autonomy, or robotics industries

- 5+ years of experience leading or mentoring marketing teams in fast-paced growth environments

- Demonstrated success supporting complex technical sales cycles and cross-functional go-to-market initiatives

- Experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns across digital, content, event, and partner marketing channels

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Experience supporting field marketing initiatives and large-scale industry event execution

- Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, including Salesforce Account Engagement or similar systems

- Ability to operate effectively in lean, fast-moving organizations with evolving priorities

- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneousl

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

- Experience marketing to U.S. defense, government, aerospace, autonomy, or critical infrastructure customers

- Experience supporting regional or international marketing initiatives across the Americas

- Background in high-growth startups or scaling technology organizations

- Experience working with channel, reseller, or ecosystem partner marketing programs

- Familiarity with long-cycle procurement environments and technical B2B buying processes

WORK ENVIRONMENT

- Hybrid work environment

- Highly collaborative and cross-functional organization

- Fast-paced operational scale-up environment supporting mission-critical customers and technologies

- Lean team structure requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution

- Up to 40% travel to support customer engagements, industry events, and internal collaboration

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

WHAT WE OFFER

This is an exempt role.
The expected annual salary range for this role is
$150,000 — $210,000 USD

If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that’s a great fit for you!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full-time, US-based employees, including:

- RSU (Restricted Stock Units)

- Generous Benefits:

- Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you

- Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA

- Virtual Care – 98Point6

- Employee Assistance Program

- Mental Health coverage through Springhealth & Talkspace (Premera)

- Travel Assistance Insurance

- Company Paid Life Insurance

- Company Paid Short & Long Term Disability

- Flexible PTO (exempt) / 15 days per year (non-exempt)

- 401(k) match

- Pet Insurance

- Prepaid Legal Program

- Commuter Benefits

- Paid Company Holidays

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a hands-on field and technical Marketing Manager to support our mission-critical radar solutions.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Echodyne is seeking a highly organized, execution-oriented Marketing Manager to support integrated marketing programs across defense, government, critical infrastructure, and related technology markets. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for a marketer who can move effectively between campaign execution, content development, event management, technical discussions, and day-to-day coordination with internal teams.

The Marketing Manager will work closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Product Management, and Sales Enablement. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple competing priorities, communicating tradeoffs, and maintaining a high standard of follow-through in a fast-paced environment.

A significant part of the role involves representing Echodyne at industry events, customer engagements, and demonstrations. The Marketing Manager must be able to quickly grasp technical radar concepts and confidently explain Echodyne’s MESA radar systems portfolio to audiences ranging from individual visitors and customer teams to large groups at trade shows and conferences.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Manage multiple concurrent marketing projects with shifting deadlines and stakeholders; prioritize work, track dependencies, communicate risks, and deliver assigned tasks on time.

- Collaborate closely with the broader Marketing team to coordinate campaigns, content, events, digital activities, product messaging, and sales-enablement priorities.

- Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to understand customer needs, regional opportunities, strategic priorities, and upcoming engagements, then translate those needs into practical marketing support.

- Support planning and execution for trade shows, conferences, customer demonstrations, and partner events, including schedules, booth operations, staffing, materials, vendors, lead capture, and post-event follow-up.

- Represent Echodyne at industry events and engage professionally with large and diverse groups of customers, partners, government representatives, media, and other stakeholders.

- Deliver clear product overviews and portfolio presentations that explain the value and applications of Echodyne’s MESA radar systems to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Develop working knowledge of radar fundamentals, customer missions, competitive technologies, and Echodyne product capabilities through collaboration with technical subject-matter experts and independent study.

- Translate complex technical concepts into accurate, accessible customer-facing content, including presentations, collateral, event materials, case studies, web content, email campaigns, and sales tools.

- Coordinate with Product Management and technical teams to validate claims, maintain message accuracy, and ensure external materials reflect current product capabilities and positioning.

- Execute digital and outbound marketing activities across web, email, CRM, marketing automation, and related channels; maintain organized campaign and contact data.

- Monitor campaign, event, and engagement performance; summarize results and recommend practical improvements to messaging, process, and resource allocation.

- Support agency, contractor, partner, and vendor coordination as needed, while maintaining brand consistency and high-quality execution.

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

- 4+ years of B2B marketing, field marketing, product marketing, event marketing, communications, or related experience in a technology-focused environment.

- 2+ years of experience in Defense, Security, or Drone-related industries.

- Demonstrated ability to organize and complete multiple competing tasks while maintaining attention to detail, responsiveness, and sound judgment about priorities.

- Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working style, with experience supporting Sales, Business Development, Product, or other cross-functional teams.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting to groups and engaging with customers in busy event environments.

- Ability and motivation to learn technical topics quickly, ask effective questions, retain key details, and explain complex concepts clearly and accurately.

- Hands-on experience supporting trade shows, conferences, demonstrations, customer meetings, or other field-marketing activities.

- Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time, including multi-day events and occasional international travel as business needs require.

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

- Experience in defense technology, aerospace, autonomy, robotics, sensors, critical infrastructure, advanced mobility, or another technically complex industry.

- Familiarity with U.S. defense, federal civilian, public-safety, or government customer environments and long-cycle technical buying processes.

- Experience creating customer-facing technical content in collaboration with engineers, product managers, or technical subject-matter experts.

- Experience with Salesforce Account Engagement or a comparable CRM and marketing-automation platform.

- Comfort working in a lean, fast-growing organization where priorities evolve and team members contribute beyond narrow functional boundaries.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

- Office-based or remote work arrangement, with regular virtual collaboration and periodic in-person meetings as required.

- Approximately 50% travel to support industry events, customer and partner engagements, demonstrations, and internal collaboration.

- Highly collaborative environment with frequent interaction across Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Product Management, engineering, and leadership teams.

- Fast-paced operating environment requiring flexibility, personal accountability, and a willingness to balance planned work with urgent business needs.

- Role may require standing for extended periods, moving event materials, and supporting setup and teardown activities at trade shows and demonstrations.

jobs.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Trade Compliance Analyst to join our fast-growing team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Support daily customs, import, export, RMA, procurement, shipping, and customer due diligence workflows.

- Coordinate routine customs matters with brokers, freight forwarders, Shipping, Logistics, Procurement, Supply Chain, RMA, and Sales, escalating off-nominal issues as appropriate.

- Review import and shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, entry records, broker inquiries, and related customs documents.

- Support HTS classification work by reviewing product information, proposing classifications for review, maintaining records, and gathering supporting information from suppliers and internal stakeholders.

- Gather and maintain country of origin, manufacturer, COTS classification, valuation, product description, and other import-related information.

- Support export control reviews by gathering facts related to products, technology, destinations, end users, end uses, parties, and transaction structure.

- Assist with customer due diligence using Dow Jones Risk Center, including restricted party screening, red flag review, and documentation of results.

- Support export license applications and other authorizations by gathering inputs, records, and supporting documentation.

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

- Minimum of 3 years of experience in customs compliance, trade compliance, import/export operations, logistics compliance, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, or a related field.

- Hands-on experience with HTS classification, country of origin, valuation, customs brokers, entry documents, and shipping documentation.

- Working knowledge of the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)

- Familiarity with restricted party screening, customer due diligence, end-use/end-user red flags, and sanctions-related transaction review.

- Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-up, and recordkeeping skills.

- Ability to manage multiple transactional requests and escalate compliance issues clearly and timely.

- Experience with SNAP-R, DECCS or supporting export license applications and other export authorizations.

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

- S. Customs Broker License or significant hands-on customs/import compliance experience.

- Aerospace, defense, radar, electronics, hardware manufacturing, or government contracting experience.

- Experience with Dow Jones Risk Center or similar restricted party screening / due diligence tools.

- Experience with Arena, NetSuite, Trello, or similar business systems.
